My loveyyy... 🥹❤️🌹

28 July 2026 · Pehle mahine par

Today 28th July... it's been one beautiful month since 28th June, the day I finally told you what my heart had been hiding for so long. ❤️✨

And you know what's the most beautiful part? 🥺💞 We've known each other since 10th class 📚❤️, but I never imagined that one day you'd become the most precious person in my life. From classmates... to my favourite person... to my home. 🫂💖

This one month gave us everything: endless smiles 😄, late-night talks 🌙📱, silly moments, little misunderstandings, ups and downs, and so much love that my heart still can't believe you're actually mine. ❤️🫶

Every single day with you feels like a blessing. 🌸 Your smile makes my day brighter, your voice calms my heart 🎶❤️, and I don't want a perfect love story... I just want to see you always be happy 🥹💍

Please always be mine... keep holding my hand no matter what happens. 🤝❤️ Let's keep choosing each other, loving each other, and growing together every single day. 🌹✨

I want countless memories with you and I want to fall in love with you again and again, every single day. 🥰♾️🥹❤️🫂😘

I love you so so so much, Lovey Babyyyy..... Forever yours.... Always. 💖🌍✨ No Nazar but yrr....... 🧿🧿

With all my love, Akshu (your gadha) 🥰💖 · #A❤️K

Here's to many more beautiful months, countless memories, and a forever filled with your hand in mine. 🤝💕♾️

28 June 2026 · Wo message jo bhejna sabse mushkil tha

Whenever something good or bad happens, you're the first person I want to tell. 😊💭 Your presence makes even ordinary days feel special. 🌞💕 Over the years, you've become such an important part of my life that I can't imagine not having you in it. ❤️

Happy Birthday Akshu 💗

1 October 2026 · Lovey ke scrapbook se, tumhare apne shabd

I met you as "Akshat Goyal", then you became Akshat, and after some time somehow you became Akshu for me. I saw Akshat as a good friend who helps, who supports, who respects. But in Akshu I found a caring partner, a supportive one, a loving one. 🧿

In the beginning you were nothing to me, then we became friends, then bestfriends, then partners, and now you are my everything. Our journey was quite interesting but not easy for us. 🥹

The sweetest Gadha is my favourite person 🫏. Even after getting you, you are still my crush. I always wished for a good partner but I got more than I ever wished. Now you are my last wish. 💗

I never chose you, I just got you, and in my opinion you are the most expensive gift by god. You are the only reason I feel happy, cared and loved. I can proudly say that you are my partner. 🫂

On VC we can't be together, I mean physical presence is not there, but still I can tease you 😁 and that is the main aim of my life 😎. You have to tolerate 😛

I want to live my entire life with you. We'll try our best that we can be together in future. 🥹💕

Love you so so so much, mera babyy, mera kuchuuu puchuuu 🥰 · Lovey · #A❤️K
